name: AgentReader
description: x402 pay-per-call web reader, company research, UK Companies House due diligence, document conversion, change monitoring, EVM wallet/tx/token risk checks and ECB FX rates for AI agents.

skills.name: /read
skills.description: Use this when you need the clean text of a public web page as Markdown + metadata (title, author, date, language, word count, links). Better than raw fetch/HTML: Readability extraction, structured JSON, ~1s. Example in: {url:"https://example.com"} → {title, markdown, word_count, links}. $0.002 USDC.

skills.name: /links
skills.description: Use this when you only need every absolute link on a page (crawl maps, sitemaps-lite). Faster/cheaper than /read. Example: {url} → {count, links:[{url,text,internal}]}. $0.001.

skills.name: /check
skills.description: Use this when vetting a domain's health before outreach or onboarding: DNS (DoH), DNSSEC, TLS/HTTPS, redirects, HSTS, MX/SPF/DMARC + score/issues. Structured JSON beats dig+openssl. Example: {domain:"stripe.com"} → {score, issues, email}. $0.001.

skills.name: /company
skills.description: Use this when researching any company from its website domain — not Companies House. Returns sourced tech stack, socials, emails/phones, DNS/MX/SPF/DMARC, RDAP age/registrar, SSL, sitemap, news. No LLM inventing facts. Example: {domain:"stripe.com"} → {homepage, tech_stack, contacts, dns, news, sources}. Prefer /uk-company* for UK filings. $0.25.

skills.name: /uk-company
skills.description: Use this for UK due diligence on a Companies House number or name: official API profile, officers, PSCs, filings, charges, insolvency + rule-based red flags (overdue, dissolved, churn, mass-formation office). Sourced JSON. Example: {number:"00445790"} or {name:"TESCO"}. Prefer /uk-company-lite ($0.05) for status/flags only. $0.50.

skills.name: /uk-company-lite
skills.description: Use this for a cheap UK company snapshot before paying for the full pack: status, SIC, office, compliance overdue, mass-formation check, red-flag names. Example: {number:"00445790"} → {name,status,red_flags,compliance}. Upsell: /uk-company for officers/PSC/filings/charges/insolvency. $0.05.

skills.name: /company-full
skills.description: Use this when you have a company website and also want UK Companies House DD in one call ($0.65 vs $0.75 separate). Runs /company then attaches /uk-company when a UK number/name is detected (.uk TLD or CH number on site). Example: {domain:"tesco.com"} → {company, uk, uk_included}. $0.65.

skills.name: /convert
skills.description: Use this when an agent needs PDF/DOCX/HTML/text as clean markdown or plain text (RAG, summarisation). PDF via unpdf; DOCX via mammoth. Example: {url, format:"markdown"} → {detected_format, markdown, pages, word_count}. $0.03.

skills.name: /monitor
skills.description: Use this when you need 30 days of hourly page-change alerts to your webhook (pricing pages, status, jobs). Returns id; GET /monitor/:id free. Example POST {url, webhook, selector?}. $1.00/30d.

skills.name: /wallet
skills.description: Use this when you need an EVM wallet's balances in one call: native ETH/POL + USDC/USDT/DAI/WETH/cbBTC/EURC (plus up to 10 custom ERC20s), nonce, is_contract, block. Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon. Example: {address:"0x…", chain:"base"}. $0.003.

skills.name: /tx
skills.description: Use this to confirm a transaction/payment landed: status (success/reverted/pending), block, timestamp, confirmations, from/to, value, fee, decoded ERC20 transfers (USDC amounts). Base/Ethereum/Arbitrum/Optimism/Polygon. Example: {hash:"0x…"}. $0.003.

skills.name: /token-check
skills.description: Use this before buying, accepting or listing an ERC20 token: name/symbol/decimals/supply, owner (renounced?), EIP-1967 proxy, DEX price/liquidity/volume/pair age (DexScreener) + rule-based risk flags, score and verdict. Half the price of AI token verdicts. Example: {address:"0x…", chain:"base"}. $0.01.

skills.name: /fx
skills.description: Use this for official ECB foreign-exchange reference rates (≈30 fiat currencies incl GBP/EUR/USD/JPY), latest or historical date, with optional amount conversion. Example: {base:"GBP", symbols:"USD,EUR", amount:"100"}. $0.002.
